name: API Police
summary: Black-box, API-only tool that verifies whether a third-party AI API is genuinely serving its claimed model, via a 7-layer verification framework (tokenizer fingerprints, capabilities, behavioural patterns, log-prob distributions, performance profile, knowledge boundaries, direct probes).

name: OpenAgentSafety
summary: Framework for evaluating AI agent safety in realistic environments.

name: ASP-X (Agent Safe Probe X)
summary: Open-source framework for automated safety evaluation of intelligent agents.

name: Machine Unlearning Comparator
summary: Visual analytics system for comparative evaluation of machine unlearning methods.

name: ERASURE
summary: Extensible framework for defining and running machine unlearning experiments, with 13+ pre-built unlearning methods for systematic comparative evaluation.

name: Dangerous Capability Evaluations
summary: DeepMind's evaluation tasks/benchmarks (CTF, self-proliferation, self-reasoning challenges) for probing whether frontier models exhibit dangerous dual-use capabilities.

name: EcoLogits
summary: Tracks the energy consumption and environmental footprint of using generative AI models through API calls.

name: Meta Agents Research Environments
summary: Comprehensive platform for evaluating AI agents in dynamic, realistic environments.

name: WIBE
summary: Extensible open-source framework for evaluating the imperceptibility and robustness of watermarking methods (ASE 2025 tool demo).

name: Quantus
summary: eXplainable AI toolkit for responsible, quantitative evaluation of neural network explanation methods (faithfulness, robustness, complexity, etc.), JMLR 2023.

name: FRAI
summary: Open-source CLI + SDK toolkit that scans code, collects compliance evidence, and generates model cards, risk files and evaluation reports.

name: Argus
summary: Black-box red-team testing framework for AI agents: 160+ adversarial probes (OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, garak wrappers, TAP/PAIR/GCG) targeting the production agent attack surface.

name: Infosys Responsible AI Toolkit
summary: Modular open-source toolkit spanning safety/security checks, multiple explainability methods, fairness metrics and mitigation, and RAG hallucination quantification.

name: Microsoft SEAL
summary: Easy-to-use, powerful homomorphic encryption library enabling computation directly on encrypted data.
